scenarios.description: Return a dynamic text response from the request URL.
Read one path parameter and render it.
Run one synchronous middleware before the response.
Run one asynchronous middleware before the response.
Resolve one asynchronous component and render HTML.
Select a full-page or fragment representation from a request header.
Parse and validate a URL-encoded form submission.
Parse and validate a JSON submission through each framework's validation machinery.
Derive the response from an application-scoped service (module closure vs DI-injected singleton).

resources.note: startup probes run in fresh Bun subprocesses; readyMs is performance.now() read at app-ready, i.e. process-boot → app-ready — raw: hand-rolled 9-route switch handler with no framework; bundar: App registration + compileRoutes + middleware composition; carno: @carno.js/core DI container + controller JIT compilation through the public listen(0)/stop() lifecycle; rss is process.memoryUsage.rss() after the build
